: "${TOME_LUAJIT:?set TOME_LUAJIT to the manifest-compatible LuaJIT}"
: "${TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT:?set TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT to the project LuaRocks tree}"
repair_tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/repair-w67-validation.XXXXXX)
env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua .ai/task/repair-w67-20261005/baseline/mod-tome.lua "$repair_tmp/mod-baseline.jsonl"
env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua mod-tome.lua "$repair_tmp/mod-current.jsonl"
env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua .ai/task/repair-w67-20261005/baseline/tome-cults.lua "$repair_tmp/cults-baseline.jsonl"
env LUA_PATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?.lua;$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/share/lua/5.1/?/init.lua;;" LUA_CPATH="$TOME_LUAROCKS_ROOT/lib/lua/5.1/?.so;;" "$TOME_LUAJIT" tools/lua/load_locale.lua tome-cults.lua "$repair_tmp/cults-current.jsonl"
python3 - "$repair_tmp" .ai/task/repair-w67-20261005/NEW-TARGETS.json <<'PY'
import json
import pathlib
import sys

tmp = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
new_targets = json.loads(pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
expected = {
    "mod": new_targets["fc55a88fd602ed5d2b8326d1f91d116116c44c1c5d2a9a94c4c364e15f21b04d"],
    "cults": new_targets["9d3fc01bdf37e358131c3837beb44ef55eccf2509a576826c6ce9a31947351a0"],
}
all_changes = []
for stem in ("mod", "cults"):
    baseline = [json.loads(line) for line in (tmp / f"{stem}-baseline.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    current = [json.loads(line) for line in (tmp / f"{stem}-current.jsonl").read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
    assert len(baseline) == len(current), (stem, len(baseline), len(current))
    changes = []
    for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(baseline, current), 1):
        if before == after:
            continue
        before_without_target = dict(before)
        after_without_target = dict(after)
        old_target = before_without_target.pop("target", None)
        new_target = after_without_target.pop("target", None)
        assert before_without_target == after_without_target, (stem, index, before, after)
        changes.append((index, after, old_target, new_target))
    assert len(changes) == 1, (stem, len(changes))
    index, record, old_target, new_target = changes[0]
    exp = expected[stem]
    assert record["kind"] == "translation"
    assert record["section"] == exp["section"]
    assert record["source_tag"] == exp["source_tag"]
    assert old_target == exp["old_target"]
    assert new_target == exp["new_target"]
    all_changes.append((stem, index, record["line"], record["section"], record["source_tag"]))
assert len(all_changes) == 2
print("LuaJIT locale load: PASS (4 files loaded)")
print("Semantic baseline comparison: PASS (exactly 2 target-only changes)")
for row in all_changes:
    print("change:", *row)
PY
printf 'validation_tmp=%s\n' "$repair_tmp"","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":12000});text(r.output)
